title: A dynamic format string is the internal measure Table[_<measure> FormatString], evaluated per row
query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS ( Sales[Item], "Sales Amount", [Sales Amount], "Fs", IGNORE ( 'Sales'[_Sales Amount FormatString] ) )

source.quote: The internal measure for the format string is [_Sales Amount FormatString].
source.supports: the format string expression of a measure is reachable as the internal measure _<name> FormatString, which Power BI queries with IGNORE next to the measure
the format string expression, with SELECTEDMEASURE () the measure's value

derivation: Per item, SELECTEDMEASURE () is [Sales Amount] there: A 500 <= 1E6 gives "#0,.00", B 2000000 > 1E6 gives "#0,,.00 M", C 1500 gives "#0,.00".
